grammar.summary: 本课学习 suppose 表设想与 react to 的搭配。

points.title: suppose 表假设
points.explanation: Suppose you were the driver. suppose = 假设，用于展开假想情境，考试指令语常见。

examples.en: Let us suppose that a child suddenly crosses the road.
examples.cn: 假设一个小孩突然横穿马路。

points.title: in the event of 表"万一"
points.explanation: in the event of + 名词 = 如果发生……，正式书面语。

examples.en: He reacted promptly in the event of danger.
